title: Boolean decision for a list of literals
statement: Given a sign assignment and a finite list of literals, the Boolean test that returns true exactly when at least one listed literal holds returns true if and only if there exists a literal in the list that holds under the assignment.
hypotheses_covered: the assignment is a sign vector of length $n$
the literals form a finite list of coordinates and required signs
